description: This file defines API endpoint functions for managing assets and related entities in a frontend application. It includes functions for login, listing, creating, updating, deleting, copying assets, and handling associated mappings, site assets, and throughput calculations. It also contains a data mapping function for transforming backend asset data into a frontend-friendly format.
